title: University of Otago International Master's Research Scholarship
deadline_central_display: No fixed closing date - reviewed in four rounds: 1 March, 1 June, 1 September and 1 November
deadline_note: Applications are reviewed on 1 March, 1 June, 1 September and 1 November. Check the page for the dates applying to the current year.
application_cycle: Four review rounds per year (1 March, 1 June, 1 September, 1 November); an application completed by 1 March will be viewed by the department in March and a decision can be expected in April-May
status_note: The University of Otago publishes this scholarship on its scholarships site together with its review rounds.
tuition_coverage_note: The University states a tuition fee waiver for 1 year capped at NZ$35,000 for Master's study, excluding the student services fee and insurance, and warns that depending on the programme of study the scholarship may only partially cover the cost of tuition fees.
benefits: Tuition fee waiver for 1 year capped at NZ$35,000 for Master's study
Up to four scholarships on offer
Reviewed in four rounds a year, so a missed round only costs a few weeks
eligibility: International students who are applying for a thesis-based Master's at the University of Otago
Must meet the University of Otago's general higher research degree admission requirements
requirements: Apply for admission to a thesis-based Master's at Otago
Complete the application by the relevant review round
Refer to the applying process for international master's research and doctoral degrees
coverage: Tuition fee waiver for 1 year capped at NZ$35,000 (excludes the student services fee and insurance)
application_method: Apply for admission to a thesis-based Master's and apply for the scholarship through the same process
application_route: Apply through Otago's admission process for international master's research and doctoral degrees; the scholarship application follows the same route.
duration: Up to 1 year of full-time enrolment covering the thesis component
description: The University of Otago International Master's Research Scholarship is available to international students who are applying for a thesis-based Master's at the University of Otago.

verification.notes: Stipend, tuition waiver and cap, exclusions, number of scholarships on offer and review rounds were read directly from the University of Otago scholarship page. The forensic audit in the catalogue notes a discovered additive benefit of a one-year tuition fee waiver for the thesis year not represented elsewhere in the catalogue, which this page confirms.

applicant_utility: This scholarship is only for thesis-based research masters, so if you are considering a taught master's you need to look elsewhere. The package is NZ$18,204 a year as a stipend plus a tuition waiver capped at NZ$35,000 for the single year of thesis study. That NZ$35,000 cap is the number to watch: international tuition for many Otago master's programmes exceeds it, and the University is explicit that the scholarship may only partially cover tuition depending on your programme, with on-fees such as the student services fee and insurance excluded entirely. Budget the gap before you accept. The good news is timing flexibility - applications are reviewed four times a year on 1 March, 1 June, 1 September and 1 November, so a missed round costs you weeks rather than a year, and with only up to four offered the competition is tight but not impossible.

title: University of Otago Doctoral Scholarship
deadline_central_display: No fixed closing date - awarded in quarterly rounds (March, June, September and November) with applications due by the first day of the round month
deadline_note: Applications must be completed, including a completed departmental assessment, by the first day of each round month. Check the page for the dates applying to the current year.
application_cycle: Awarded in quarterly rounds each year (March, June, September and November)
status_note: Otago states it is currently reviewing the strategic direction of its doctoral scholarship programme and directs applicants to its funding-announcement page for the current position.
tuition_coverage_note: The University states a domestic tuition fees waiver for 36 months, excluding the student services fee and insurance, and for professional doctorates a tuition fee waiver of up to 36 months capped at the domestic tuition rate.
benefits: Domestic tuition fees waiver for 36 months
For professional doctorates, a tuition fee waiver of up to 36 months capped at the domestic tuition rate
Number awarded: up to 153 annually, spread across four quarterly rounds
eligibility: Students undertaking a PhD or professional doctorate at the University of Otago
Applications for a scholarship must be completed, including a completed departmental assessment, by the first day of each round month
requirements: Completion of document application steps and a completed departmental assessment by the first day of each round month
Refer to the applying process for international master's research and doctoral degrees
Check Otago's funding announcement page for the current status of the doctoral scholarship programme
coverage: Domestic tuition fees waiver for 36 months (excludes the student services fee and insurance)
application_method: Apply for doctoral admission at Otago and apply for the scholarship through the same process, including the departmental assessment
application_route: Apply alongside doctoral admission through Otago's process for international master's research and doctoral degrees, with the application complete by the first day of the round month.
description: The University of Otago Doctoral Scholarship offers NZ$34,128 stipend per annum plus a domestic tuition fees waiver for 36 months for PhD study, and up to NZ$34,128 stipend plus a tuition fee waiver capped at the domestic tuition rate for professional doctorates.

verification.notes: Stipend, tuition waiver, exclusions, number awarded and quarterly round structure were read directly from the University of Otago scholarship page. Otago has published an important doctoral funding announcement stating it is currently reviewing the strategic direction of its doctoral scholarship programme and directing applicants to its funding-announcement page, which should be checked before applying.

applicant_utility: Otago's doctoral scholarship is one of the larger stipends in New Zealand - NZ$34,128 a year plus three years of domestic-level tuition fees - and up to 153 are awarded across the year in quarterly rounds, which is unusually generous by NZ standards. Three things to plan for. First, the application is not just yours: it needs a completed departmental assessment by the first day of the round month, so talk to your prospective supervisor weeks in advance rather than days. Second, the tuition waiver is at the domestic rate for professional doctorates, so a DBA or EdD may still leave you owing the difference. Third, the student services fee and insurance are excluded, so add those to your budget. Most importantly, Otago has published a funding announcement saying it is reviewing the direction of its doctoral scholarship programme - read that page before you commit to Otago over another institution.
